home.allStopsDone: All stops on this trip are done.

map.placeholder: Route preview. Open Navigate for turn-by-turn directions.
map.noNextStopBody: Start a trip or wait for today’s assignments.

notifications.stubHint: Sample alerts for preview. Live push inbox is not connected yet.
notifications.sampleNewJobBody: A trip was added to your inbox for today.
notifications.sampleUpdateBody: Stop details or timing may have changed.
notifications.sampleReminderBody: Complete pending stops before end of shift.

comingSoon.body: This section will connect to the ERP when the mobile API is available.
comingSoon.helpBody: Contact your dispatcher for support. In-app help will expand later.

vehicleCheck.localOnly: Open a planned trip to complete the pre-trip vehicle checklist.

checklist.title: Pre-trip checklist
checklist.requiredBody: Complete and pass all checklist items before starting this trip.
checklist.photosOptional: Photos are optional and do not block Start trip.
checklist.incompleteBody: Mark Pass or Fail on every item before saving.
checklist.passedBody: All items passed. You can start the trip.
checklist.failedBody: Every item must Pass before you can start the trip.
checklist.lockedBody: This checklist cannot be edited after the trip has started.
checklist.stubBody: Open a planned trip from Jobs, then complete the vehicle checklist before Start trip.

permissions.title: Required permissions
permissions.subtitle: JS Group Driver needs location, notifications, camera, and photo/video access to operate. Please allow all to continue.
permissions.locationBody: Used to attach your position to proof of delivery.
permissions.notificationBody: Used to alert you about assigned trips and updates.
permissions.cameraBody: Used to take delivery proof photos.
permissions.mediaBody: Used to choose proof photos from your gallery.
permissions.deniedBody: You must allow Location, Notifications, Camera, and Photos & videos before using the app. Enable them in Settings, then tap Try again.
permissions.cameraMediaDeniedBody: Allow Camera and Photos & videos to capture or select proof photos.

login.subtitle: Sign in to continue
login.noRegisterHint: Accounts are created by admin. There is no self-registration.

jobDetail.readOnlyHint: Trip not started yet. You can review details, call, or navigate. Start job and Complete unlock after you start the trip.
jobDetail.completedHint: This job is completed. You can still review details and proof photos.

trips.title: Today’s trips
trips.emptyMessage: When dispatch assigns you a trip for today, it will show up here. Pull to refresh.
trips.emptyCompletedMessage: Finished trips for today will appear here after you end a trip.
trips.cannotStart: This trip cannot be started from the app in its current status ({{status}}).
trips.startBeforeStops: Start the trip before starting jobs.
trips.notStartedBody: Start the trip before working stops.
trips.completedDialogBody: All stops on {{tripNo}} are done. End this trip to mark it Completed?

stops.title: Stop
stops.missingTrip: Missing trip context for this stop.
stops.signatureHint: Sign inside the box with your finger.
stops.signatureEmpty: Please draw a signature before saving.
stops.photoRequiredBody: Add at least one proof photo to complete this stop.
stops.startNextBody: Start {{job}} now? This records the job start time for commission. Choose Later if you are not ready — the next job stays pending.
stops.startNextHint: Next job is waiting. Tap Start next job when you are ready — that records the start time. Complete ends the job.
stops.nextJobStartedBody: Job start time recorded. Complete the job with proof when finished.

proofs.title: Proof photos
proofs.emptyMessage: Upload delivery or pickup proof images for this job.
proofs.deleteBody: This removes the proof photo from the job.
proofs.longPressDelete: Tap to view · long-press to delete

settings.title: Settings
settings.stillRequired: Location, notifications, camera, and photos & videos remain required to use the app.
